course.title: Data Structures and Algorithms

content.value: You are designing a hash table for a university database with a large number of student (12) [CO4] records. Collisions are expected to be frequent. Decide whether you would use chaining or open addressing to handle collisions. Justify your choice in terms of memory usage, search/insert/delete efficiency and handling of high load factors.
